card.name: Slash or dash before second number
card.fires_on: The separator or label just before the second number in a pair or range, such as the slash in blood pressure values or the word Day, Week or Cycle after a start or end point. It is strongest in dose schedules and vital-sign figures.

modes.label: Blood pressure slash
modes.description: The slash between systolic and diastolic change values in mmHg.

modes.label: Day or week label in schedule
modes.description: The word Day, Week or Cycle right before the number in a dosing schedule or range endpoint.

modes.label: Dash in numeric range
modes.description: A hyphen or minus sign that joins two numbers in a range or a change value.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a second number is about to appear, as in a blood pressure pair or a day-of-treatment schedule.
